verdict.rationale: The only deletion evidence is that agents can run DELETE and modify schemas through the remote MCP server's query_rw tool. DuckLake also lets users bring their own cloud object storage, which gives some control over where data physically lives. Neither amounts to a documented retention or deletion control, so support is glancing. missing for 10: documented data retention policies or TTL settings, account or organization data deletion guarantees, backup and snapshot retention controls, retention of MCP/AI interaction data, independent corroboration.
